caption: Same rain pan with probes enabled in both: v2.0.2 renderer (66fcc404, same alley fixture backported) and #263 (f885d98). The sheltered car window reflects less sky and the crew takes the shade. Both already include #253: covered floors stay dry. Matching camera, sky, seed and High settings; normal-speed Forward+ software-Vulkan capture, without grading.

Godot arguments: --audio-driver Dummy --rendering-method forward_plus --resolution 960x540 --fixed-fps 30
Use a windowed offscreen game, not --headless (headless has no RenderingDevice).
Godot reports:
Vulkan 1.4.305 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: Unknown - llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, 256 bits)
Compatibility reports:
OpenGL API 4.5 (Core Profile) Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 - Compatibility - Using Device: Mesa - llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.7, 256 bits)

Timing limitations: no /dev/dri or /dev/nvidia device, including outside the sandbox.
Cold startup/scene compilation takes several minutes; first valid frame can take over ten minutes.
Tank frames took approximately seven seconds each with two concurrent renders; full-town weather is slower.
Actual cgroup memory.max is 17179869184 (16 GiB). Two simultaneous renders plus an import caused two OOM kills.
Run exactly one renderer at a time and complete imports before capture; monitor memory.current and memory.events.
Fixed 30 fps is simulation/capture time, not wall-clock rendering throughput.
GALLIVM_PERF=nopt disables LLVM optimizations to shorten compilation; unsuitable for hardware performance conclusions.
Keep capture separate from any performance test. Hardware renderer cost remains unmeasured.

Bounded follow-up: one renderer at a time throughout. Full High 960x540 coastal
frames take roughly 5–10 wall seconds apiece on this software setup; a 3-second
fixed-30 clip therefore takes many minutes plus atlas preparation. #263's matched
pair additionally uses LP_NUM_THREADS=4 on both sides to fit the4CPU quota.
No timing here estimates a discrete or integrated GPU's frame time.

For this263 pair only: LP_NUM_THREADS=4 in both runs.
camera_match: Per-frame camera matrix, world time, scenery count and warming state compared within1e-5.
preparation: Pause simulation during scenery setup, replay probe atlas GPU jobs with drawing enabled, await queues empty and20 rendered warmup frames. Resume simulation for capture. No grading/interpolation/speed change.
limits: Software driver only; shader-clock rain sparkle and foliage need not align pixel for pixel. No hardware-performance claim. The visible car-edge stippling remains in both builds. One alley entry does not establish all unit models, weather or camera transitions. Wall removal is checked separately in local-only footage.
trim: Encode captured frames0–71 at30fps; omit the last0.6seconds where the camera passes the subjects. No speed change, synthetic hold or interpolation.
fixture: The exact 18-line alley case from f885d98 is backported only into the temporary baseline mapgen.gd. Baseline lighting/material code is untouched.
fixture_source:
"alley":
			# two houses across a narrow alley with a car parked in it under the
			# eaves, a gun team holding the houses and a rifle squad out in the
			# street, all one side's: the light probes' shade on men indoors and in
			# the open, and on wet paint and glass the sky can't reach (--mood=rain)
			_house(Vector3(0, 0, -30), 8.0, 6.0, 0.0, 1.0, false, 0.0)
			_house(Vector3(0, 0, -38.5), 8.0, 6.0, 0.0, -1.0, false, 0.0)
			_spawn("car", Vector3(1.0, 0, -34.25), PI * 0.5, -1, {"variant": 1})
			var gq := r.spawn_squad("mg_team", 0, a, Vector3(0, 0, -30))
			gq.order_defend(Vector3(0, 0, -30), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
			var rq := r.spawn_squad("rifle_squad", 0, a, Vector3(0, 0, -20))
			rq.order_defend(Vector3(0, 0, -20), Vector3(0, 0, 1))
			# and an AT team put in the alley's shade, a squad out in the sun at its mouth
			var aq := r.spawn_squad("at_team", 0, a, Vector3(-2.5, 0, -34.25))
			for i in aq.members.size():
				aq.members[i].position = Vector3(-3.0 + i * 1.6, 0, -34.25)
			var sq := r.spawn_squad("rifle_squad", 0, a, Vector3(-12, 0, -34.25))
			sq.order_move(Vector3(-12, 0, -34.25), Vector3(-1, 0, 0), 0, false)
movement: At capture start, the open-mouth rifle squad receives the same jog order to(-2.5,0,-34.25), facing+X,tactical=false. All per-frame member positions are compared within1e-5.
